column3: Settled just behind the pace off the rail - travelling wide in the pack - 4th at halfway - into 3rd with 4f left and up to 2nd approaching the 3f pole - pushed along 2f out - hit the front a furlong out and edged away soon after - kept going strongly to the line

Sat behind front group early - drifted wide in places - third at halfway - up into second with 4f left and edged ahead just past the 3f marker - driven forward but overtaken with a furlong to go - unable to find more when asked and stayed on at same rate to the line

Sat handy behind the front group travelling keenly - went in front after 5f and opened a big gap by halfway - eased back and lost the advantage 8f out - regained command with 5f to run - overtaken 3f out and asked for effort in third with no response - pressed for more 2f out - faded late to finish third

Went straight to front fighting for control - lost pace after 5f then regained command 8f from home - overtaken past the 5f pole - pushed along in 4th with 4f left - dropped away sharply and trailed home last
Settled just behind leaders early - 5th at halfway - urged into contention 5f from home - unable to threaten leaders 4f out - dropped away to finish last
Held up towards rear from the start - lost touch with field after 6f - urged on around halfway - lost more ground 7f out - trailed in well adrift last of all
Set the pace from the start - roused with a furlong left and edged away - drew away easily to win
Sluggish start settling towards the back - pressed for effort with 2f left - progress and finishing well through the final furlong - grabbed second close home but unable to get to winner
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - found some late progress and kept battling inside the closing furlong - couldn't land the runner-up spot in the final 110yds finishing third
Held up at rear fighting the bridle - made progress over 2f out then pushed along approaching final furlong - stayed on inside to finish fourth
mid-pack early - pushed along over 2f out and kept going at one speed - lost momentum inside final furlong to finish fifth
Held second early - pressed for effort 2f out then lost touch - dropped away and finished well beaten in 6th
Went straight to front - driven approaching 2f out and had two lengths in hand entering final furlong - held on gamely though margin shrank near the line - got the verdict
Sat behind the pace - third at halfway - pushed along approaching final two furlongs and made progress on the inside - moved to second close home then edged left and stayed on strongly for 2nd
Held up towards the back - driven to make progress through the field approaching 2f out and into 7th with a furlong left - finished strongly to snatch 3rd near the line
Sat behind the front group early - fourth turning halfway - asked for effort 2f out - moved up to second a furlong out - eased back to third and held late finishing fourth
Held a midfield spot early - asked for effort with 2f left and holding fifth as pressure applied inside final furlong - responded nicely in the closing stages to finish 5th
Sat close behind pace - second at halfway - driven approaching final 2f - dropped to third with a furlong left then held finishing berth
Held up towards the back of the pack - urged along with 2f left - stayed on at same tempo inside the last
Settled in the pack - 5th at halfway - driven approaching final 2f - unable to threaten and stayed on same gear to finish 8th
Held up at the back throughout - driven approaching the final furlong with little response - finished ninth without finding more
Away cleanly - settled in the middle of the pack - slipped back towards the tail 3f out - no response below 2f out and allowed to coast home
Up with the leading duo - advanced to second over 2f out - took up the running approaching the final furlong - kept up to work and never in doubt

Went forward early and fought for the bridle - overtaken at halfway but stayed in touch - back in front inside the final 3f - pressed for effort over 2f out - overhauled inside the final furlong - stuck on for the runner-up spot

Settled in the pack - moved into third around 4f out before slipping back approaching the 3f pole - regained momentum 2f out but boxed in briefly - kept on at one speed under pressure through the final furlong to finish third
towards the back early - urged forward and made ground approaching 2f out - then asked for more but unable to find extra - finished fourth
Prominent early in second and pulling hard - moved to front at halfway - lost the advantage approaching 3f out and dropped away
Slow to break - held towards the back and driven up with 2f left to make some late inroads - lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish sixth

Settled towards the back early - up to 6th four out - blundered three out - moved into second before the following fence - went clear approaching the last and driven out - asked for effort again after jumping it - kept going strongly to the line

Up with the front group - 5th at the fourth last and minor errors at the second last saw momentum interrupted - tight for room approaching the final fence before moving into 3rd - progressed to 2nd in the home straight - unable to land a blow and stayed on at the one speed to finish second

Settled towards the back early - up to 7th with 3 furlongs left - shaken up into 4th soon after - moved second on the outside approaching the last but unable to threaten the leader in the straight - stayed on same effort to finish third

Handy early - shared front spot then went clear after 2nd - blundered 6th - left-handed error and untidy 2 out - pushed along and overtaken before last - 4th at final fence - held on without finding more
Settled midpack early - up to 4th by halfway before dropping to 7th and hampered 2 out with nothing to offer - driven but faded late to finish 5th
Handy early up with the pace - third at halfway - fifth and unable to close 2 out - driven but faded - well beaten in 6th
Settled midpack early - clipped a couple early obstacles - dropped towards the back and blundered 4 out - driven along but faded and pulled up before the final furlong
Settled at the back on the wide outside - scrappy over the first two fences - untidy again 5th and 6th - lost touch quickly and eased out of contention before the following fence

Raced up with pace and shared command early - lost the advantage after 2nd and settled behind the front-runner - scratchy over 5th and 6th - driven for effort but made no dent approaching 2 out - down in 4th when fell at that fence
Handy early - settled midfield after the opening stages - still 8th and not going forward approaching 3 out - dropped away before being eased and pulled up inside the last furlong

Took a strong hold early - settled just behind the front group - asked for effort with two furlongs left - moved to the front approaching the final furlong and quickly opened daylight - edged leftward but comfortably in command inside the last - won going away
Took a strong hold early - tracked the front group - moved right for room over 2f out - made progress under pressure inside the final two furlongs - unable to quicken again and finished second
Settled in a forward spot early - pushed along to hit the front approaching the final 2f before being overtaken with a furlong left - dropped away inside the closing stages to finish third
Set the pace early - lost the advantage and pushed along approaching 2f out - dropped away quickly through the final furlong
Held up towards the back early - improved into 5th by halfway then hit the front approaching the final 2f - driven out to assert and stayed on strongly to the line
Set the pace early - driven and lost front spot approaching 2f out then dropped to third with a furlong to run - rallied into second close home and finished strongly
Detached in the field - strong move made inside the final 2f - finished well to claim 3rd close home
Sluggish start settling towards back - urged into action but made no headway two out - still in eleventh and driven approaching final furlong - closed strongly to finish fourth going away at the line
Sat close to the front early - second at halfway - dropped to fifth and driven with a furlong left - stayed on at one gear to the line finishing fifth
Held a midfield spot early - still 7th at halfway - pushed along inside the last furlong and stayed on at one speed to finish sixth
Held a central berth early - asked for effort with 2f left and down to 8th inside final furlong - stayed on to close finish

Held up towards the back of the pack - squeezed for space with a furlong left after being niggled at - stayed on at one speed inside the final furlong - finished eighth beaten just under three lengths
Held a midfield position early - asked for effort with 2f left and up in 7th under pressure inside final furlong - stayed on at same tempo to finish 9th beaten under three lengths
Sat handy behind the front group - third at halfway then second and pressed approaching final furlong and a half - held no more inside the closing stages
Sat close to the pace - 4th at halfway - driven approaching final 2f but unable to find more inside the closing stages
Held up towards the back - stayed there through the race - driven for effort inside final furlong - made no headway and finished well beaten in 12th
Sat close to the front early - driven to keep tempo but slipped back at halfway - unable to find more inside the final furlong - finished well held in 13th
Sat close to the pace early - 6th at halfway - pushed along and unable to quicken inside final furlong - eventually finished 14th

Held up towards the back - made steady progress and shifted right 2f out - into third with a furlong left under strong urging - upped alongside the front-runner close home - got up to win in the final strides
Set the pace early - pushed along 2f out and kept finding more - came under pressure inside the final furlong - fought back gamely - caught in the last strides to go down by a nose
Slow to break - held towards back - driven approaching final 2f and kept responding - moved into third late but no threat to leading pair
Held a forward position early - driven into second place 2f out while drifting left approaching the final furlong - unable to find more inside the closing stages - finished fourth beaten 3.75 lengths
Held up at back of pack - made progress 2f out - pushed along inside final furlong and unable to quicken - finished fifth
Sat behind the front group early - urged forward before the 2f marker - stayed competitive briefly then dropped away close to the line
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished seventh
Settled in the pack - pushed along with two furlongs left - unable to close and hampered a furlong out - well held at the finish
Handy early - urged into effort but slipped back over 2f out - eased further behind through to the line - finished 9th
Held a midfield spot early - pushed along and dropped away with two furlongs left - finished tenth well beaten
Held up towards the back - urged forward with over 3f left - unable to respond - beaten a long way home in 11th
Held up at the back - urged into effort by halfway - dropped away and well beaten - finished last of the field

Went off fast and front from the outset - soon opened a gap - margin trimmed at the 2nd - slight error at the 6th left position precarious - jumping errors at the 7th and 2 out - niggled into the last - challenged inside the final furlong but kept on to win

Sat close to the pace early - fighting for control - drifted right at the opening obstacle - up into 3rd by halfway - hit the fence 3 out - urged forward after - moved left before the last to move into 2nd - driven out inside the closing furlong - kept on but narrowly denied

Sat behind the front-runner early - untidy over the obstacles with errors at the 4th and 6th while up in second - further blunders at the 2nd last and last cost momentum - driven into third but couldn't find more - stayed on at one gear - unable to find another gear in the closing stages - finished third

Settled just off the front group on the inner - hampered a touch and unhurried at the 1st - 6th by halfway after veering left there - up to 4th and veering left again 2 out - driven for effort soon after - error at the last blunted any threat - driven out but one-paced to the line - finished fourth
Settled towards the back early - minor error 5th - driven into 5th but not threatening leaders after 2 out - error at the last then dropped away

Sat close to the pace early - dropped towards the back and stumbled at the 4th - up in 4th spot at halfway - stumbled again 6th - wide ground with another error following - unbalanced 3 out - pressed for effort and faded away to finish well beaten

Settled towards the back early - up to 5th at halfway - bumped a touch two out from there - mistake at the following fence and driven to keep up - slipped back through the field 3 out - faded quickly and finished well beaten
Settled in the pack early - roused with over a furlong left - closed hard to loom up inside the final furlong - burst clear inside the last 110yds and kept finding more to score
Held up at rear - pushed along over 2f out - progress inside final furlong - stayed on to grab second close home but couldn't get to winner
Settled second early - moved up to hit the front two furlongs out - came under pressure in the closing stages and edged back inside the final 110 yards - dropped to third close home
Took a strong hold early and went straight to the front - fought hard when overtaken with 2f left - faltered inside the final furlong - had nothing left in reserve and slipped from third close home
Sluggish start - eager and settled midpack - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on at one speed without troubling leaders
Settled at the back early - driven into contention approaching 2f out and hit the front with a furlong left - driven out to assert inside the final 150 yards
Held a midfield position - asked for effort 2f out sitting 4th and drifted left to move into 2nd inside the final 150 yards - stayed on strongly to finish 2nd beaten a length and a quarter
Settled towards the back early - driven into contention approaching final 2f and up to 2nd for a moment inside the last - eased back to 3rd but battled on to the line
Set the pace early - urged on with two furlongs left then overtaken a furlong out - unable to find more inside the final 150 yards and beaten into 4th
Sat close to pace early - second at halfway - asked for effort 2f out then slipped back to 5th inside final furlong - held no more late

Sat close to the front group early - 4th at halfway then pressed for effort approaching 2f out and slipped to 6th with a furlong left - couldn't find extra gear and finished steadily without threatening
Sat behind the front group early - third at halfway then asked for effort - faded to the back inside the final two furlongs and could find no more
Held up in the pack - pressed for effort with no response entering the closing stages - urged again but couldn't find more - kept on same pace to the line

Set the pace from the off - clear margin kept slim early on - urged into action with 2f left - kicked clear inside the final furlong under pressure - drifted left approaching the closing stages but held on to score
Tracked the pace-setter - urged forward with two furlongs left then driven approaching the final furlong - stayed on to finish second
Sat behind the leading duo - driven approaching 2f out - kept on same speed to finish third beaten 1¾ lengths
Tracked the front group early - driven to stay in touch inside final 2f - kept going at one gear to finish third
Settled in the pack early - roused approaching halfway - unable to land a blow thereafter - finished fifth
towards back of field - pressed for effort with a furlong left - unable to improve position - finished sixth beaten 4¼ lengths
Held up at the back - failed to feature - finished well off the pace in 7th
Took a firm hold in the middle of the pack - under pressure 2f out - faded over 1f out to finish 8th

Settled just behind the pace on the rail - 4th at halfway - 3rd approaching two out after an awkward jump and given encouragement - found room to move through and hit the front entering the run-in - kept going strongly to the finish

Nudged into contention early and soon up with the front rank - hampered at the 1st but travelling in touch - took up the running before the 3rd - not clean at the 4th - held a slender margin 2 out - hard at work at the last - caught and passed entering the straight - plugged on without threatening to close the gap

Up with the field early - drifted left and erred at the 1st - settled 3rd then moved into 2nd at the 6th - in contention 2 out - untidy at the last and into 3rd in the straight - plugged on without threatening

Settled in the pack early - briefly second at a modest gauge - up to 6th with three left - urged into 5th approaching the final furlong - 4th at the last - asked for more but couldn't find extra and finished steady without threatening the front

Settled handy early - hit front approaching 1st but not smooth over it - lost lead before 3rd - held 3rd by 6th - down to 4th before 2 out - driven from there - dropped to 5th at last and held on for no more finishing near fifth

Held up in the pack - drifted left at the first and dropped towards the back after an untidy second - up with the front group by the third - sixth at halfway - lost momentum 4 out and niggled at - another awkward leap 2 out - laboured at the last with no response to pressure - faded into sixth

Held up at the back - clipped heels and untidy over the opening fence - up in 8th by halfway - lost touch and stumbled 4 out under a driving ride - unsettled again 2 out before fading out of contention
Held up at the back - 7th at halfway - up to 5th with 3 to jump - driven approaching 2 out but made no headway then dropped away

Up with the front group - jumping errors at the 1st and 2nd - 5th at halfway - nudged into stride and not slick at 4 out - 7th at 3 out - scrubbed at and fell back before 2 out where another jumping blunder and hampered - faded into the distance to finish 9th
Settled midfield early - bumped a touch at the opening fence then 9th at halfway - driven into contention before falling two out
Held up in the pack early - driven into command approaching final 2f - powered away inside the last to score comfortably
Settled at the rear early - urged into contention approaching final 2f - stayed on to the line without troubling the winner
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with 3f left - moved through the field approaching the final furlong - closed inside final furlong to claim third close home
mid-pack early - roused along with 2f left and pressed the pace-setter inside the final furlong - faded fast in the closing stages - dropped from third close home to finish fourth
Handy in the early stages - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away rapidly soon after - well beaten at the finish
Set the pace early - pushed along and lost the front spot over 2f out - dropped away quickly - well behind by the final furlong - finished sixth well beaten
Sat just behind pace early - still in second at halfway - asked for effort with 2f left before hitting front early in the last furlong - held on strongly to the line
Set the pace early - driven to keep up 2f out and lost front spot approaching final furlong - unable to close in the closing stages
Sat close to the pace - 4th at halfway - asked for effort over 2f out then edged right and up to 3rd inside final furlong - stayed on to finish 3rd
Sat close to pace early - third at halfway then driven approaching 2f out but couldn't close 1f out - held on for fourth without finding more
Sprang from the stalls smartly then dropped towards the back - driven with two furlongs left but found nothing - allowed to drop away inside the final furlong
Handy in the pack early - pushed along under pressure inside final furlong to fight back and forth with rival - got there close to home to score
Set the pace under pressure from early stages - driven approaching final 2f - continued to battle on - urged forward inside final furlong - overhauled by a whisker close home
Sat behind the leading group early - urged forward approaching 2f out - moved left with a furlong to run - kept going but couldn't find enough speed to get on terms
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - kept on late without getting close enough
Sat close to front pack - urged forward with over 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong - finished fifth
Handy early - urged into effort with 2f left - lost ground approaching final furlong - finished sixth beaten 4 lengths
Held up at the back - urged forward approaching halfway - failed to figure - finished seventh
towards the back - urged forward around halfway - never a factor thereafter - finished 8th beaten 5.5 lengths
Held a midfield position - urged forward with over 2f left - no response - finished ninth beaten 5½ lengths

Seized control immediately and opened up a commanding gap - margin trimmed at halfway - surged further ahead and 10 lengths to the good 2 out - nudged through and met the last awkwardly - stuck on strongly after the final fence to score

Held up in contact - tracking the front-runner in 4th at halfway - hampered 3 out - left in a weak 2nd after the following fence - niggled into the last - no headway on the winner after that and plugged on at the one speed to finish 2nd

Handy early and second soon after start - tracking the front-runner - drifted left and hit the deck three out then again at the following fence - driven into third before the last where errors continued - asked for effort after the final flight but found little more - held late for third

settled towards the back and untroubled early - clipped the first fence - up to 6th by halfway - driven into 5th after the second-last - clouted the final fence and lost footing - unable to find any response after

Settled in early - pressed the front-runner soon after start - third by the midway point - lost rhythm and caught out three from home - driven into fourth after two out then dropped away toward the finish
Settled off the pace early - fifth and stumbled 4th fence - unbalanced and mildly bumped 3 out - pushed along into 6th after 2 out and faded
Settled towards rear early - urged into 8th before 4th and still there at halfway - no headway made and scratchy over 3 out - dropped away after finishing 7th
Held up towards back early - 7th at halfway - bumped lightly 3 out - unable to close and dropped away late

Settled at the back early - fighting for control with the bit - error at the 3rd - stumbled again soon after - urged forward but making no headway before 3 out - blundered 2 out - dropped away and finished last
Went straight to front - urged along approaching final 3f - lost advantage for a stride inside final furlong - fought back and edged clear again - stayed on well to the line

Up with the pace - pushed along 2f out and moved up to front over 1f out - veered left shortly after - caught and wandered right inside the final furlong - kept on and carried left near the line - just denied in a short-head verdict
Took a strong hold early - tracked the pace - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on inside final furlong but held for third
Handy early - urged forward with over 2f left - unable to make further headway - held on for fourth
Took strong hold early - anchored at the back and pushed forward from 3f out - lost touch under pressure inside final 2f to finish well beaten
Held a handy spot early - pushed along with 3f left - dropped away over the final 2f to finish sixth
Sat close to the front pack early - nudged into the advantage 2f out - driven out with a furlong left and stayed on strongly to the line
Shared front spot early - driven to keep tempo before being overtaken 2f out - into second and urged 1f out - stayed on same rate but couldn't get to winner in final furlong
Shared the front early - driven and lost advantage 2f out then third and urged with a furlong left - stayed on at same effort to finish 3rd beaten a length
Held up early - improving through the pack from 2f out to reach 6th inside the final furlong - driven and finished well to take 4th close home
Held a midfield spot early - urged forward in 6th two furlongs out - driven approaching the final furlong and stayed on at one speed to finish fifth
Sat close up behind front group - 4th and asked for effort 2f out - stayed on same rate under pressure but made no further gain to finish 6th
Held up at the back - improved into 5th by halfway - into 4th and pressed for effort with a furlong left - couldn't get on terms and held to finish 7th
Sat behind the front group early - settled midfield by halfway - driven with no response inside the final furlong and held to finish eighth
Slow into stride and back in the pack - urged for effort inside the last two furlongs - couldn't find a way through and stayed held in the closing stages
Settled towards the back - nudged for effort inside final two furlongs - stayed on same speed through closing stages - unable to threaten leading group - finished tenth
Held up in the pack - off the bridle approaching final furlong and unable to land a blow - one-paced to finish 11th
Held up at the back throughout - made no headway from over a furlong out - unable to find more late and beaten
Handy early - driven approaching final 2f - hit front inside final furlong and opened up - kept finding more to win going away
Tardy start - dropped in at the back - progress from 2f out under pressure - contesting third a furlong out - closed on the front runner inside the final 110yds but unable to peg them back
Just in front early - driven approaching final two furlongs - overtaken with a furlong left - stayed on same speed for third
Sat close to the pace early - driven approaching 2f out - unable to find further headway - finished fourth
Held up at the back of the pack - driven approaching the final furlong - found nothing under pressure - finished fifth
held up towards the back - pressed for effort over a furlong out - never got competitive - beaten into 6th
Sat close to the front early - pushed along with 2f left - faded from over a furlong out to finish 7th
Held a midpack spot early - urged forward outside two furlongs and drifted left under pressure - dropped away from there to finish well behind in 8th

Sat handy in 3rd on a firm grip - moved through to head affairs after the 5th - driven on and closely challenged approaching the final fence - urged out after jumping it - kept finding more to prevail

Settled early and fighting for the bridle - sluggish into 2nd then sitting off the pack near the back at halfway - into 4th after the 5th - driven into 3rd approaching the last - asked for more but unable to close after the last - forged into 2nd inside the final furlong - finished one-paced for second

Set the gallop from the front - a little untidy over the opening obstacle - swished occasionally - lost the advantage after the 5th and settled into second - closed up before the last but again scratchy there - asked for more soon after with nothing forthcoming - held to third with no response inside the final furlong

Sat close to pace early on a tight rein - up to 3rd after the 5th before hesitating and being urged forward - held 4th spot into the last where hesitating again - finished without response - beaten well into 4th
Settled just behind the pace early - minor error 3rd then up in 4th at halfway - error at 5th sent back through the field - driven when hesitant two out - faded from there finishing fifth
Held a central position early - clear from the front throughout - pushed out to open the gap a furlong out - margin narrowed close home but held on gamely for the win
Sat handy in the middle of the pack - urged forward with over two furlongs left and travelling at an even tempo - closed inside the last but denied by the winner
Settled handy in midfield pulling hard - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground soon after - dropped away inside final furlong to finish third
Set the pace from the off - eased into a two length advantage inside the final furlong under pressure - driven out and held the line to the finish
Held up towards the back of the pack - urged into contention with two furlongs left and moved into second close home after edging left - stayed on to the line
Held up at the back - driven into contention approaching 2f out and up to 6th with a furlong left - stayed on grimly to snatch 3rd close home
Sat close to the front group early - third at halfway - pushed along with two furlongs left but couldn't find extra from a furlong out - held for fourth and stayed on steadily to the line
Settled just behind the front-runner - second at halfway - pressed for effort inside final two furlongs but made no headway and faded to finish fifth
Sat just behind the pace - fourth at halfway - pushed along two out and dropped to fifth before flattening out inside the final furlong
Settled midpack early - eased back with pressure applied inside final 2f and down to 9th with a furlong left - rallied through the closing stages
midpack early - 5th 3f out but driven with no headway inside 2f - held no more late
Held up towards the back - driven at halfway without gaining ground - stayed on same rate late having been outpaced throughout
Settled in the pack early - pushed along around a furlong and a half out but failed to close - soon faded thereafter - finished well back in 10th
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along with no headway approaching 2f out - held to the line
Set off in front from the start - opened up a big advantage more than 2f from home - driven out approaching the final furlong - stayed on strongly to the line unopposed
Settled just behind the leading duo - asked for effort 2f out to take second - kept going but no match for winner - finished second beaten 2 1/4 lengths
Held up towards the back - driven for effort with 2f left and finished with some late progress - moved into third close home without threatening the front pair
Sluggish start - driven into the pack near the back but not far off the pace after two furlongs - kept trying but always outside the shake-up
Sat close to front group early - dropped back at halfway - driven from there but unable to improve - finished 5th
Held a midfield spot early - urged forward with over 2f left - unable to find any headway - finished 6th beaten 4¼ lengths
Tracked the pace early - lost touch with the winner over 2f out - faded into the pack thereafter - finished 7th

Hit the front early - lost the advantage by a whisker after the 4th - locked together with rivals 3 out - jumped awkwardly two out and regained command - minor error at the final obstacle - driven out after jumping it - finished going away strongly

Settled just behind the front group in 3rd - fighting to hold rating early - slipped to 4th two out - squeezed for space nearing the last - into 2nd after the last but unable to threaten - stayed on at one speed to finish 2nd
Settled in midfield - 4th at halfway - niggled into 5th after 2 out - stumbled at the last - unable to make any headway in 4th - stayed on at one speed into 3rd final 100 yards

Up with the pace - error at the 2nd and again at the 4th before edging to the front - challenged and blundered 3 out then lost the lead at the following fence - mistakes continued at the last and dropped to 3rd - no threat to those ahead and faded into 4th

Slow to settle towards the back - still off the pace approaching halfway in 5th - improved to 3rd but scrambled over two out - into 4th before drifting left over the last - lost momentum under pressure and dropped away - beaten well into 5th
Settled just off the pace early - 6th at halfway - lost fluency 3 out - driven but made no headway - dropped away after the following fence to finish well beaten

Restrained in midfield but carrying excess enthusiasm early - slipped to last at the 1st and cleared fences cautiously - errors at the 5th and 6th saw the pace demand immediate riding - blundered 2 out and faded to finish a distant 7th
Sat behind the front group early - third at halfway then second with two furlongs left - hit the front a furlong out under pressure - edged away inside the final 150 yards to hold on strongly
Settled just behind the pace - fourth and urged forward by halfway - shaken up to move third with a furlong left - stayed on to snatch second late but couldn't threaten the winner

Handy up front and went ahead by halfway - kicked two lengths in front approaching final two furlongs before being overtaken a furlong out - couldn't find further response and slipped to third near the line
Held up towards the back - urged into contention past halfway and 9th with 2f left - stayed on strongly in the closing stages to finish 4th
Held a midfield position - 6th and driven for effort with 2f left - stayed on at one speed inside the closing furlong to finish 5th
Settled around midfield early - 7th at the halfway point - pushed along and nudged up to 4th for a moment with a furlong left before fading to finish sixth
Handy behind the front group early - 5th at halfway then 3rd and driven 2f out - dropped back to 5th inside final furlong - held with no more response late finishing 7th
sat close to the front group early - 6th and driven up by halfway - failed to threaten with 2f left - then dropped away for 8th
Held up towards the back - urged forward with over 2f left - down in 11th and given some encouragement inside the final furlong - stayed on at same effort without threatening late on
Held up at the back - unable to make headway 2f out - stayed on same speed inside final furlong to finish well held
Sat close to pace early - drifted into midfield and driven for effort by halfway - couldn't find more inside final 2f - finished well held in 11th
Held up towards the back - made no impression through the pack - couldn't find any response inside the final furlongs - well beaten in 12th
Set the early pace - overtaken at halfway and dropped away quickly - had nothing left approaching the final 2f and faded well held
dwelt and settled at the back throughout - no meaningful response when ridden over 2f out - well held
Sat handy just behind the front group - still 4th at halfway - improved to 3rd and driven with a furlong left - moved through to hit the front close home and stayed on strongly
Held a midfield position - asked for effort and made progress inside the final two furlongs - driven and finished strongly to snatch second late
Sat behind front group early - 6th at halfway - driven up to hit the front with 1 1/2f left - overtaken close home and held on for third

Sat close to the pace early - up to 2nd by halfway - hit the front for a moment 2f out before being reeled in and pressed for effort a furlong later - unable to find more inside the final furlong and a half and eased back to finish 4th
